Abaqus 复合材料建模
请提供在 Abaqus 中建立复合材料层合板有限元模型的步骤，包括材料定义、铺层设置、边界条件和后处理方法。
Nastran 复合材料分析
请说明在 Nastran 中进行复合材料结构分析的 PCOMP/PCOMPG 卡片定义方法，以及常用的求解序列。
损伤容限设计
请解释复合材料结构的损伤容限设计方法，包括损伤类型分类、检测门槛值和剩余强度评估流程。

夹层结构设计
请设计一种复合材料夹层结构（面板+芯材），包含面板材料、芯材类型、厚度配比，并校核其抗弯刚度和剪切稳定性。
连接设计
请对复合材料结构中常见的机械连接（螺栓连接、铆接）和胶接接头进行强度分析和设计建议。

en: Composite Laminate Design
Design a composite laminate layup scheme, including material system selection, ply angles, stacking sequence, and design justification.
Laminate Strength Analysis
Perform strength analysis for the following composite laminate, calculate stress distribution in each ply, and evaluate against strength criteria.
Composite Failure Analysis
Analyze the failure mode of the following composite structure: fiber fracture, matrix cracking, delamination, or interfacial debonding. Provide improvement recommendations.
Material Selection
Recommend suitable composite material systems (fiber type, matrix type) based on the following engineering requirements, with justification.
Composite Standards
Search for composite design or testing standards (ASTM, ISO, GB, etc.) related to the query. Summarize the scope of each standard.
Mechanical Property Prediction
Predict the elastic constants (E1, E2, G12, ν12) and strength parameters (Xt, Xc, Yt, Yc, S12) of a unidirectional composite based on constituent properties and fiber volume fraction.
Abaqus Composite Modeling
Provide the steps for building a composite laminate finite element model in Abaqus, including material definition, layup setup, boundary conditions, and post-processing.
Nastran Composite Analysis
Explain the PCOMP/PCOMPG card definitions and recommended solution sequences for composite structural analysis in Nastran.
Damage Tolerance Design
Explain the damage tolerance design methodology for composite structures, including damage classification, detection thresholds, and residual strength assessment.
Hygrothermal Effects
Analyze the effects of hygrothermal environments (hot-wet, cold-dry) on composite mechanical properties and recommend compensation measures in design.
Sandwich Structure Design
Design a composite sandwich structure (facesheet + core), including material selection, thickness ratio, and verify bending stiffness and shear stability.
Joint Design
Perform strength analysis and provide design recommendations for mechanical joints (bolted, riveted) and adhesive bonds in composite structures.
Fatigue Life Assessment
Evaluate the fatigue life of the composite structure under cyclic loading, considering S-N curves, residual strength degradation, and damage accumulation.
Cure Cycle Optimization
Provide recommendations for optimizing the cure cycle of the composite manufacturing process (temperature profile, pressure schedule) to reduce residual stress and improve quality.
NDI Plan
Develop a non-destructive inspection plan for the composite structure, including applicable methods (ultrasonic, infrared thermography, X-ray CT) and inspection intervals.
